name: hyperfine
description: Command-line benchmarking tool with statistical analysis and warmup runs

hyperfine.description: Statistical benchmarking tool with warmup runs and JSON output support
hyperfine.usage:
hyperfine 'command1' 'command2' # Compare two commands
hyperfine --warmup 3 'command' # Run 3 warmup iterations
hyperfine --min-runs 10 'command' # Minimum 10 benchmark runs
hyperfine --export-json results.json 'command' # Export to JSON
hyperfine --prepare 'setup-command' 'main-command' # Setup before each run
